notes.title: We’re LIVE at Wholesome Celebration with a Localization Update!
notes.notes:
[h3]Today's the big day![/h3]

We’re excited to announce a new [i]localization update[/i] just in time for [b]Wholesome Celebration 2024![/b]

[previewyoutube=oM56U-KnoR8;full][/previewyoutube]

Thanks to our amazing community, the Lost and Found Co. demo is now available in [b]12 languages[/b]: 
[list]
[*] English
[*] French
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[*] Spanish
[*] German
[*] Italian
[*] Russian
[*] Turkish
[*] Indonesian
[*] Traditional Chinese
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Thai
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050414/b7096608f4f4fcaf2e5e0aea62636a41aab944a9.gif[/img]

[b]Play the new localized demo today![/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2179510/Lost_and_Found_Co_Demo/

We hope you enjoy it—let us know your thoughts! 💖

- Ducky
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050414/8779bf7670596dd16d2a08500fb85f148d314ce4.png[/img]
